event: PO 78214 Rev 1 for 800 units is transmitted through VendorLink.
Bright Meadow Foods acknowledges every Rev 1 line as Accepted.
Northstar transmits authorized Rev 2, increasing quantity to 1,000 and moving Ready By and delivery dates.
Bright Meadow Foods acknowledges every Rev 2 line as Accepted within one Northstar business day.
Vendor submits a complete dry-truckload SRR request more than three Northstar business days before the Rev 2 Ready By time.
Northstar tenders the shipment to Granite Span Transport with a September 16 pickup window.
Vendor confirms a production shortfall and determines only 900 of the acknowledged 1,000 units will be available.
Vendor gives timely shortage notice and requests a 100-unit reduction; Northstar issues no further PO revision.
Nine hundred conforming units are staged, documented, released, and available at the approved origin before the 10:00 Ready By deadline; the missing 100 units are not ready.
Granite Span reports that Northstar's assigned tractor has failed and pickup will be delayed more than two hours.
Replacement tractor arrives at the vendor origin.
Carrier signs the BOL and departs with 900 units.
After DockSchedule records No Show at 11:00, the carrier gates at HVDC at 13:42, after both the appointment tolerance and the Rev 2 destination delivery window ending at 12:00.
HVDC completes receipt of all 900 presented units as compliant and Accepted with Exception; no later units arrive by final close.
A preliminary score export incorrectly uses destination arrival for managed-pickup timeliness and reports 0.0% On-Time and 90.0% Fill.
Vendor timely requests a PER removing the entire OTIF failure based on the Northstar carrier delay.
Procurement and Logistics identify separate carrier-timing and vendor-quantity components; no approval is granted in the discussion.
PO final close occurs five calendar days after the controlling delivery window ends, with 900 compliant units received.
